$comment: Single source of truth for Squad's published distribution identities. `current` is what this tree builds and publishes; `legacy` lists retired identities that existing installs and generated configs may still reference. To change an identity, edit `current` (moving the old value into `legacy`) and run `node scripts/rename-distribution-identity.mjs --write --from <old>` for each renamed entry. See docs/src/content/docs/get-started/package-rename.md.
